description: Run /pan:feedback's engine (pan-tools feedback) from an installed package on a project with a canary planted in every place PAN keeps free text. The report counts what happened and carries none of them; a control that leaks phase names into the installed renderer is refused by the report's own privacy scan.
why: The learning report exists to be shared. Its promise is that it cannot carry the project: allowlist construction, coarse counts, and a fail-closed scan. Unit tests prove it in the source tree; this proves it in the packed install a user runs, and the control proves the scan still stands when the allowlist is broken.

steps.why: The installed engine builds the report: the reviewer's five quality findings, all dismissed, are counted, and the machine block is there.

None of the planted canaries (a token, a password, an e-mail, a client name in the phase directory and roadmap, a file path, home paths, an IP, a custom model id and config key) appears in the report.

controls.why: A renderer that copies a phase directory name (the client's name) into the report must be refused by the scan: exit 1, no report printed.
